label: FSU: Computer Science (B.S.)
source: FSU transfer guide for Computer Science (BS) (the published sample is the TCC-to-FSU version)

requirements.note: Physics can replace biology only for students with dual-enrollment or AP credit for MAC 2311.
Use the same subject as part 1.

notes: FSU requires a C- or higher in each prerequisite and a minimum 2.50 overall GPA, which must be maintained to stay in the major.

The published guide is the Tallahassee Community College version. The prerequisite list is FSU's, but its year-by-year sample plan is TCC-specific, so confirm MDC equivalents with an FSU or MDC advisor.
Whether a student who placed directly into calculus still needs MAC 1105, MAC 1140 and MAC 1114 should be confirmed with FSU.
FSU's guide does not list a programming prerequisite.
